cvs_analysed_check.name: cvs_analysed_check
cvs_analysed_check.value: "core"."cvs"."status" not in ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'CONFIRMED') or ("core"."cvs"."profile" is not null and "core"."cvs"."profile_masked" is not null and "core"."cvs"."pii" is not null and "core"."cvs"."analysis_model" is not null and "core"."cvs"."analysis_source" is not null)

skills_soft_skill_family_check.name: skills_soft_skill_family_check
skills_soft_skill_family_check.value: "core"."skills"."family" is null or ("core"."skills"."group" is not null and ("core"."skills"."group" = 'SOFT_SKILL') = ("core"."skills"."family" in ('COMMUNICATION', 'TEAMWORK', 'LEADERSHIP', 'PROBLEM_SOLVING', 'PRESENTATION', 'CRITICAL_THINKING', 'SELF_LEARNING', 'TIME_MANAGEMENT', 'PROACTIVENESS', 'RESPONSIBILITY', 'ADAPTABILITY', 'ATTENTION_TO_DETAIL')))

skills_suggestion_check.name: skills_suggestion_check
skills_suggestion_check.value: ("core"."skills"."suggestion" is null) = ("core"."skills"."suggestion_model" is null) and ("core"."skills"."suggestion" is null) = ("core"."skills"."suggestion_prompt_version" is null)

match_results_eligible_check.name: match_results_eligible_check
match_results_eligible_check.value: "core"."match_results"."eligible" = ("core"."match_results"."criteria" is not null) and "core"."match_results"."eligible" = ("core"."match_results"."skill_fit" is not null) and "core"."match_results"."eligible" = (jsonb_array_length("core"."match_results"."ineligible_reasons") = 0)

match_results_llm_part_check.name: match_results_llm_part_check
match_results_llm_part_check.value: ("core"."match_results"."prompt_version" is null) = ("core"."match_results"."model" is null) and ("core"."match_results"."prompt_version" is null) = ("core"."match_results"."assessment" is null) and ("core"."match_results"."prompt_version" is null) = ("core"."match_results"."s_cv" is null) and ("core"."match_results"."s_cv" is null) = ("core"."match_results"."scv_breakdown" is null)

match_runs_dispatched_check.name: match_runs_dispatched_check
match_runs_dispatched_check.value: "core"."match_runs"."dispatched_at" is null or "core"."match_runs"."job_id" is not null
